scope: Theorem 8.9 (Canonical uniformization comparison) of the manuscript “Canonical conformal limits of subcritical FK planar maps” (preprints/Canonical-conformal-limits-of-subcritical-FK-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e7dab39caf778176), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 67. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Keep any joint extraction of the finite- map encoding and its local observations. Let x1 n, x2 n, x3 n be the actual independent mn-samples used to define ϕn. In the reference coordinate these marks converge jointly to three conditionally independent samples z1, z2, z3 of µh. The maps ϕn ◦ H−1 n have uniformly convergent subsequences, and every limit is the Möbius or anti-Möbius map taking (z1, z2, z3) to (0, 1, ∞). All retained local observations use this same limiting coordinate and the same possible orientation sign.
